messages.en:
{07 14 00}Yo, check this out!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}The {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}gave me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}They finally gave me credit
for all the effort it took
to pull that room together!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Jou, vaata seda!{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 0d 00}{ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa Akadeemia
{ff 00 00 00}andis mulle {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}!
{07 14 00}Nad lõpuks tunnustasid
kogu vaeva, mis kulus selle
toa kokkupanekuks!

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I gotta ask, {ff 00 00 05}{04 1f 00}{ff 00 00 00}...{01 00 00 0a 00}
Are you a member of the{01 00 00 05 00}
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 14 00}Yeah, well, I am, and they
gave me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points
{ff 00 00 00}this time, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 0d 00}They don't just give away
points like that; I got it
'cuz I filled my collection!

{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Did you get your recent
{ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy
{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}results, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}I got me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00}!{01 01 00}
Yeah! {01 00 00 05 00}'Cuz I worked the
feng shui of the place!
{07 0b 00}That's it, right? {01 00 00 05 00}Feng shui?{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 15 00}Someone better tell me
what that is...or POW!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}{07 0b 00}Kas sa said oma hiljutise
{ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa Akadeemia
{ff 00 00 00}{01 00 00 05 00}tulemuse, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}Mina sain {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00}!{01 01 00}
Jah! {01 00 00 05 00}Sest ma tegelesin
koha feng shui'ga!
{07 0b 00}Nii see on, eks? {01 00 00 05 00}Feng shui?{01 00 00 14 00}
{07 15 00}Keegi ütleks parem, mis
see on...või PÄMM!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Are you doing all that
{ff 00 00 02}{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00} stuff,
{04 1f 00}?
{07 00 00}This time I decided to{01 00 00 05 00}
collect a bunch of items 
that looked the same...
{07 14 00}Worked out pretty well!{01 00 00 05 00} It
earned me {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} points{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa tegeled kogu selle
{ff 00 00 02}{01 00 00 05 00}{07 0b 00}Õnneliku Toa Akadeemia{ff 00 00 00}ga,
{04 1f 00}?
{07 00 00}Seekord otsustasin ma{01 00 00 05 00}
koguda hunniku asju, 
mis nägid sarnased välja...
{07 14 00}Läks päris hästi!{01 00 00 05 00} See
tõi mulle {ff 00 00 02}{04 0f 00} punkti{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, {04 1f 00}, didja join
{07 0b 00}the {ff 00 00 02}Happy Room Academy{ff 00 00 00}?

{07 00 00}I did, but...{01 00 00 05 00}I guess it's
still too early for them to
rate my room.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}I think the first thing I 
need to do is organize my
weights, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii, {04 1f 00}, kas liitusid
{07 0b 00}{ff 00 00 02}Õnneliku Toa Akadeemiaga{ff 00 00 00}?

{07 00 00}Mina liitusin, aga...{01 00 00 05 00}vist on
veel liiga vara, et nad mu
tuba hindaksid.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 06 00}Ma arvan, et kõigepealt
pean ma oma raskused
korda seadma, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
